series.title: Return puts Netherlands’ largest BESS online
series.summary: BESS owner-operator Return has put its 100MW/200MWh Antares BESS in the Netherlands into commercial operation, the largest to have reached that stage in the country as far as we know.

series.title: B2U CEO: US second-life BESS can compete with ‘China price’
series.summary: Energy-Storage.news Premium speaks with Freeman Hall, CEO of second-life BESS firm B2U Storage Solutions.

series.title: Actis buys 1.14GWh of BESS in Poland from DTEK’s DRI
series.summary: Infrastructure investor Actis has entered the Polish energy storage market with the acquisition of two large-scale projects from DTEK's DRI, while R.Power and Solax have announced project updates in the country.

series.title: Mint Renewables wins planning approval for 800MWh battery storage system in Western Australia
series.summary: Mint Renewables has received planning approval for an 800MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) near Kojonup in Western Australia.

series.title: IEA: Thermal energy storage key to industrial heat electrification that could cut EU gas demand by 35 bcm annually
series.summary: Electrifying low-temperature industrial heat and steam processes with renewables could reduce European Union natural gas consumption by 35 billion cubic metres-per-year, according to a report from the International Energy Agency (IEA).

series.title: Finland: BESS acquisition, construction and optimisation news from Usva Energia, Nala Renewables, Centrica and Olana Energy
series.summary: Finland is the Nordic region’s most-talked-about market for the moment, with project deals and other battery storage development activity from local and international players.

series.title: Europe’s system integrators move quickly on sodium-ion with CATL: ‘surprised if we aren’t deploying it next year’
series.summary: Intilion has just tied up with CATL for sodium-ion BESS deployments in Europe, following Alfen’s similar move in July, while Merus Power tells us it is in the process of integrating with the OEM’s new product.

series.title: South Africa pursues 4.6GW of battery storage deployments in Integrated Resource Plan
series.summary: South Africa’s government has put battery storage and power-to-gas technologies at the heart of the national long-term electricity supply and demand strategy.

series.title: BESS Industry Buzz: Optimisation and curtailment in GB, deal-making and revenues across Europe
series.summary: Another edition of our BESS Industry Buzz, taking a look at what’s got industry people talking in the corridors of social media.

series.title: Australia home battery installations surge 52% to 276,011 in H1 2026, outpacing rooftop solar growth
series.summary: Australians installed 276,011 home battery storage systems in the first half of 2026, 52% more than in the previous six months.

series.title: ASEAN Centre for Energy, IEA say Southeast Asia’s battery storage adoption barriers are mostly regulatory, not technical
series.summary: ACE and the IEA say the main obstacles to battery energy storage system (BESS) deployment in Southeast Asia are policy and market rules.

series.title: Chile: Engie commissions 802MWh BESS, Grenergy finances 1,769MWh
series.summary: Power group Engie has put an 142MW/802MWh BESS project in Chile into operation, while IPP Grenergy has secured financing for the fifth and final stage of its Oasis de Atacama solar-plus-storage project.

series.title: FERC rejects most of PJM’s large load interconnection plan
series.summary: The PJM Interconnection’s plan for curtailing large loads that don’t have matching new generation intrudes on state jurisdiction and appears to be discriminatory, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission said.

series.title: New South Wales BESS earn nearly AU$6 million as two-hour ‘extreme’ price event sweeps Australia’s energy market
series.summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Australia’s New South Wales (NSW) earned an estimated AU$5.63 million (US$3.88 million) in two hours on 12 October, as wholesale electricity prices peaked at AU$23,107/MWh.

series.title: Samsung C&T refers 800MWh Darnum BESS in Victoria’s Gippsland region to Australia’s EPBC Act
series.summary: Samsung C&T’s Australian renewables arm has referred an 800MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) in Victoria’s Gippsland region to the federal government under Australia’s Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act.

series.title: Wärtsilä energy storage JV Valo in US domestic content manufacturing discussions with ‘strong players’
series.summary: Valo, the new joint venture formed as a continuation of Wärtsilä’s energy storage business, is weighing up investing in the US supply chain, including factories.

series.title: Neoen, BW ESS and MN8 back efforts to standardise BESS procurement through new Energy Storage Contract Alliance
series.summary: Big names in the downstream battery storage market have signed up to join an initiative aimed at simplifying BESS procurement.

series.title: Visionpark unveils new foundation-free solar carport for residential use
series.summary: The Atlas range is scheduled to become available in January 2027, with three models offering PV capacities from 3 kW to 15 kW and heights of up to 4 meters. The post Visionpark unveils new foundation-free solar carport for residential use appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Clearway Energy increases Utah ‘Energy Centre’ capacity to 2,120MWh
series.summary: Independent power producer (IPP) Clearway Energy has added 210MW of energy storage capacity to its Honeycomb Energy Centre fleet in Southern Utah, US.

series.title: Foss & Company closes US$58 million tax equity deal for GridStor’s Texas BESS project
series.summary: US tax equity syndicator Foss & Company has closed a US$58 million partnership flip transaction to finance an energy storage project in Hidalgo County, Texas, developed by GridStor.

series.title: Qatar’s renewable capacity share could more than double by 2035
series.summary: Renewables could rise from 12% of Qatar's power capacity in 2025 to 25.9% by 2035, says GlobalData, with solar leading while gas remains the backbone of its power and water system. The post Qatar’s renewable capacity share could more than double by 2035 appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.summary: European PPA prices rose 5% in September, driven by higher forward electricity and gas prices, while Spain and Portugal recorded declines. series.summary: Chinese researchers have developed high-entropy molecular contacts that enabled inverted perovskite solar cells to achieve a certified steady-state efficiency of 27.31%. series.summary: The Chinese robotics manufacturer has introduced an autonomous tracked forklift capable of transporting solar module pallets weighing up to 3,000 kg. series.title: US power prices fall with utility-scale solar, rise with rooftop
series.summary: MIT researchers say there is no link between renewable portfolio standards or utility-scale wind and solar and higher US residential power prices, but rooftop solar correlates with higher rates and distribution costs. The post US power prices fall with utility-scale solar, rise with rooftop appeared first on pv maga…

series.title: FERC approves Duke large load transmission rules despite cost-shift concerns
series.summary: Commissioner David Rosner said that Duke Energy Carolinas’ proposal offers “meaningful, if imperfect, new protections,” adding that consumer protections are “inadequate across the country” and FERC may need to take further action.

series.title: Solving California’s energy affordability crisis can help the whole nation
series.summary: The state's electricity prices are double the national average, and wildfires are a big reason — but far from the only one. Fresh leadership can show the way on regulatory, financial and operational reform, write experts at GridLab and Energy Innovation.

series.title: Battery system failures fell 98% in 7 years, but older systems need special care: report
series.summary: The Electric Power Research Institute analysis found a dramatic drop in energy storage system failures from 2018 to 2025 amid a host of technology and project improvements. “Early-vintage” systems may require retrofits, however.

series.title: Merchant exposure divides BESS investors in Japan, Singapore and Australia, DLA Piper finds
series.summary: DLA Piper finds merchant BESS appeal splits Japan, Singapore and Australia, with regulatory certainty, grid access and returns shaping investor views.

series.title: ‘Mexico’s mixed investment scheme provides clean energy investors with certainty’
series.summary: Alberto Valenzuela discusses ahead of Energy Storage Summit Latin America about Mexico's growing interest in renewables and energy storage, and the factors driving this growth.
